review_message:
New document-upload charges are not released after successful deletion, leaving managed storage quotas inflated. Frontend type-checking passed, but full runtime validation was blocked by local tooling and database-access limitations.

Review comment:

- [P2] Release document quota after confirmed deletion — /Users/shaanshoukath/Documents/TInkerspace/SpaceWorks/backend/apps/warranty/signals.py:29-32
  For managed makerspaces, warranty-document and procurement-receipt uploads now call `add_storage`, but this deletion callback and its procurement counterpart never call `free_storage`, even when deletion succeeds. Repeated upload/delete cycles therefore exhaust storage quota despite removing the bytes, until an operator runs reconciliation. Capture the size before deletion and credit it only after confirmed success, following the [storage-accounting rule](docs/INVARIANTS.md#L288-L298).
finding: New managed warranty document and procurement receipt charges are not released after confirmed deletion. Correction must prove actual local debit, exact deletion and no duplicate credit; legacy size alone is not proof.
